text:
mike_dev: getting 401 invalid_api_key from hosted API, but the key works from CI and other machines.
lina_support: can you paste the curl you run and the exact Authorization header (redact key partially)?
mike_dev: here's the curl I run on my macbook (macOS 13):
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Api-Key ***************abc\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings\" 
```
response 401, body: {\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\"}

sam_engineer: any chance the shell variable has hidden chars? echo -n "$API_KEY" | xxd -p | sed 's/../& /g' should show bytes.
mike_dev: ran that, output: 
```
61 62 63 64 65 66 67 68 69 6a 6b 6c 6d 6e 6f 70 71 72 73 74 75 76 77 78 79 7a cc 81 31 32 33
```
(notice the `cc 81` bytes before the final digits)
lina_support: cc 81 is UTF-8 for U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT — looks like a decomposed diacritic slipped into the key when copying.
sam_engineer: interesting — some mac apps (PDF copy, certain clipboard managers) can produce NFD (decomposed) sequences. our keys are normalized NFC on the backend so the extra combining mark makes it mismatch and returns invalid_api_key.
mike_dev: omg I copied from a screenshot in Keychain Access where the glyph had an accent. didn't realize it.
lina_support: quick repro: run `python -c "print('\u0061\u0301')"` to see decomposed vs `print('\u00e1')` for precomposed. but easiest fix: use the dashboard copy button or retype the last few chars. also run `echo -n "$API_KEY" | iconv -f utf-8 -t utf-8 -c` or `python -c 'import sys, unicodedata; print(unicodedata.normalize("NFC", sys.stdin.read()))'`.

sam_engineer: filing internal bug to consider normalizing incoming keys on auth path and to add a diagnostic error hint when non-ascii bytes present. created issue RDW-8471: https://internal.redwood/issue/RDW-8471 (ops-only link).
deploy-bot: issue RDW-8471 created and assigned to sam_engineer.

mike_dev: re-copied from dashboard copy button and retried — now 200 OK, embeddings returned. thanks!
lina_support: glad that fixed it. will keep RDW-8471 open to evaluate server-side normalization and better error message. :thumbsup:
